skills.skill: 解析多个 C++ 字符串字面量拼接的多子句输入时，保证子句之间保留空格，否则词法分析会把相邻子句粘成一个 token 流。
skills.trigger: 多子句字符串被直接相邻拼接，解析结果异常。
actions: 检查拼接后的实际输入字符流
在相邻字面量之间加入空格
运行解析与 DLL bridge smoke test
skills.verification: 切片报告 multi-clause loading works fine with spaces，随后 M1 bridge smoke test passes，且 clean build/link/smoke test 全部通过。
skills.scope_limit: 限定于该 C++ parser 的多字面量输入边界；不扩展为一般字符串规范。

sources.evidence: The original issue was that the three C++ string literals were concatenated without spaces
sources.result_evidence: Multi-clause loading works fine with spaces between clauses.
Clean build, DLL compilation, import lib generation, Odin linking, and smoke test — all passing end-to-end.
